verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim Arc graphics, XeSS 3 upscaling, and 'ultra-smooth FPS' for gaming, and list compatibility with major game stores, but there is no independent game benchmark data in the evidence pack to corroborate real-world frame rates or the iGPU class claims. missing for 10: independent/hands-on FPS benchmarks in real games, cache/boost behavior verification, comparative iGPU-class positioning against competitors.
